description: Hand cases for the genrePieces.* rows (PL.native-genre-rows slice 4): what core's corpora conformance/genre-pieces/ leave unpinned — the contract, the taxonomy readers (genrePieceKind with a module named, null or absent; isGenrePieceVariant over a segment, a list and no variants; genrePieceArchetype; genrePieceArtSlots), deriveGenrePieceArchetype alone, genrePieceModulesFor, a genre that is an Object.prototype member, genrePieceIdSegment and genrePieceId alone, coursePieces, puzzlePieces and campaignPieces alone, the binding walk over placed pieces and an empty list, the anchors with a campaign and a null world, placement with null pieces and anchors and non-object pieces, a plan with no world, the settle offset below 1 and between whole numbers, the writer's grounded and ungrounded plans over a world with other sections and a stale ground, and the [invalid-input] boundary of every declared member of every argument. Every expectation is computed by core's own functions at the pin (gen-bridge-genre-pieces-cases.mts, kept with the builder's record).
